concerns.text: Constitution Principle VI names TWO sanctioned covariate sources: 'the AnAge database or BirdLife International public records.' The plan treats AnAge as the sole covariate source and halts on its unavailability, but never mentions BirdLife International as the constitutionally sanctioned fallback for migration status / body mass. Add BirdLife as a named secondary source (or explicitly justify its exclusion) so the covariate sourcing complies with Principle VI as written.
